cross_validation.oof_combination: per-record mean of out-of-fold probabilities over the model's repetitions; AUROC on the mean

preprocessing.imputation: sklearn SimpleImputer() default (mean), fitted in training folds
preprocessing.scaling: StandardScaler fitted in training folds (not applied for TabPFN)
preprocessing.final_released_model: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression, fitted once on the seed-42 matched cohort (src/revision/17_final_model.py)

gradient_boosting.search: GridSearchCV(scoring='roc_auc', cv=3) inside each outer training fold

mlp.search: GridSearchCV(scoring='roc_auc', cv=3) inside each outer training fold

stage2_nested.importance: sklearn.inspection.permutation_importance(scoring='roc_auc', n_repeats=10, random_state=0) on the training fold itself
stage2_nested.rule: keep features with mean importance > 0.005 (all if none)

stage2_original_outside_cv: UNRESOLVED - code not preserved; estimator, repeats and evaluation split cannot be reported

bootstrap.unit: individual record (matched pairs not kept together)
bootstrap.pairing: same resampled indices for the compared models

matching.rule: cases from oldest to youngest; random unused control, same sex, |age difference| <= 2 y; fallback <= 3 y without the sex constraint
